name: Fitness CLI (scripts/fitness.py)
purpose: Deterministic half of the /fitness skill: classify a topic, print the production plan, scaffold a Sinew project, regenerate the kit's library.js, check the asset manifest against the kit, validate the research dossier and the quality review, and render the brand sheets.

installation.instructions: Workspace file; python3.12 (jsonschema) for schema checks.

compatibility.runtime: python3.12; node + puppeteer-core from the hyperframes install for sheets
compatibility.notes: sheets takes the host render lock (src/pipeline/hostlock.py).

licensing.notes: Internal workspace component; no third-party code copied.

security.notes: Writes inside projects/<slug>/, src/studio/kits/fitness/library.js and assets/fitness/.

approval_evidence: Used to build projects/how-muscles-grow and covered by tests/test-fitness.py (2026-11-08).
